Privacy Policy - Pixel Play Games

Pixel Play makes casual mobile games. This policy explains what we collect when you play.

What we collect
We collect your nickname, device identifiers, in-game purchases and gameplay statistics. We use them to run the game, prevent cheating and improve our products.

Children
Our services are not intended for persons under 18 years of age and we do not knowingly collect their personal data. If we learn that a minor has given us personal data, we will delete it.

Advertising
We show advertisements from partners. You can limit ad personalisation in your device settings.

Contact us
Write to support@pixelplay.example with any privacy questions.
